guitar.evidence: Joe Satriani's Ibanez JS signature series is extremely well documented, one of the longest-running guitarist signature lines in the industry.

tone.target: saturated Satriani lead with wah, delay, and singing sustain
tone.profile: saturated Satriani lead with wah, delay, and singing sustain
tone.summary: A saturated, mid-forward signal chain utilizing a Tube Screamer boost into an AC30 or UK 45 style amp, enhanced by Wah, Chorus, and Digital Delay for signature Satriani leads.
corrections: Lean more legato lead than crunch

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Simulate the Tube Screamer boost for mid-hump and sustain.
blocks.gap: The dedicated TS model is absent, so 'Boost' is used to achieve a similar mid-focused push.

alternatives.reason: If the Boost doesn't provide enough grit.

blocks.purpose: Provide the signature sweeping wah effect.
Add width and stereo shimmer to the lead lines.
Provide high-gain saturation and sustain without pure fuzz.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is the best fit for controlled, articulate lead gain (avoiding Fuzz/Muff).

alternatives.reason: If more aggressive grit is needed.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British lead tone (AC30) with strong mid-focus.
Provide a classic British cabinet sound to complement the AC30.
Achieve the required long, shimmering delay for lead lines.
Add spaciousness and sustain to the overall tone.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR for better realism and articulation to match Satriani's high-gain lead tone.

proposals.recommendedAsset: song-appropriate IR (e.g., Celestion Vintage 30 or similar)
proposals.reason: Enhance the articulation and presence of the high-gain lead tone.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and punch in the mids.
